name: Summer Spice Summoner!
original_name: さまーすぱいすさもなー！
source:
One summer day, the protagonist is suddenly summoned to the demon world along with their partner.
It turns out to be Bunyan Island, the birthplace of Bunyaan.
translation:
One summer day, the protagonist is suddenly summoned to the demon world along with their partner.
It turns out to be Bunyan Island, the birthplace of Bunyaan.
